upstream.license: not present in the published artifact

surface: Clean-room Octane Skeleton and BoneSuspense components plus the documented registry, configuration, responsive selection, snapshot, and HTML rendering APIs.
divergences: Consumers import from @octanejs/boneyard instead of boneyard-js/react.
The Playwright capture CLI, Vite plugin, descriptor layout engine, React Native adapter, and non-Octane framework adapters are not included.
The package was implemented clean-room because the boneyard-js 1.9.0 npm artifact does not carry a recognizable license file.
ssr: Supported when initialBones or a registry entry is available; the static skeleton markup is emitted without DOM measurement.
